title: Lenient MCP Request Meta
description: Decode MCP _meta as an open map on tools/call, resources/read, prompts/get, and list requests so extra keys such as claudecode/toolUseId do not fail strict params decoding. Keep every other params field strict. Add a Go regression test that tools/call with _meta progressToken plus claudecode/toolUseId succeeds, then rebuild semio-repo-mcp.
summary: MCP request params now decode _meta as an open map, so tools/call accepts extra client keys such as claudecode/toolUseId while every other field stays strict.
